Corollary
[Weyl and Ricci parts of the zero-Weyl quadratic] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0127, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0128 ↗ lem:chow-ii-quadratic-zero-weyl ↗ lem:chow-ii-ricci-contraction-wedge 1. ch11:11.36\group Curvature Operator Algebra If $R_W=0$, then \[ Q(R)_W=\frac1{n-2}(\operatorname {Rc}_0\wedge \operatorname {Rc}_0)_W \] and \[ \operatorname {Rc}(Q(R))=-\frac2{n-2}(\operatorname {Rc}_0^2)_0 +\frac{n-2}{n-1}\bar\lambda \operatorname {Rc}_0 +(\bar\lambda ^2+\sigma )\operatorname {id}. \]
Proof

\sketch Project the formula of 4 to the Weyl summand, then apply 3 and use $\operatorname {Rc}_0^2=(\operatorname {Rc}_0^2)_0+\sigma \operatorname {id}$.

□
